heading: Today
text: Areas of low clouds and fog lifting for some sun north, more clouds south. Rather cool breezes.
temperature: Mid 50s to mid 60s north to south

heading: Monday Night
text: Periods of clouds, thinner north, with isolated frost.

heading: Tuesday
text: Becoming mostly sunny north, increasing sun south.

heading: Wednesday
text: Morning valley fog, then sunny, a few clouds south
